title: The Rusted Toll-Chain
summary: Gnoll raiders dragged the heavy iron ferry-chain into the shallows below the Old Border Mint, halving river crossings. Haul the chain links back before high water.
objectives: Clear the Briar Hounds scavenging near loc-border-mint-ruin
Recover 3 Heavy Toll-Chain Links from the river mud
Return the chain links to Clerk Oswin
accept_line: That iron took three smiths a winter to forge; drag it out before the mud swallows it.
complete_line: Greased and riveted—the ferry runs again, though my ledger will never recover.

steps.journal: Clerk Oswin needs the heavy iron ferry-chain dragged back from the shallows below the ruined Border Mint.
Drove off the Briar Hounds scavenging near the Border Mint ruins.
Pulled three forged iron chain links out of the river silt.
Returned the iron links to Clerk Oswin so the ford ferry can winch across again.

title: Sunken Peat-Spades
summary: Bog-gas flares drove Mara's cutters from the southern hollow, leaving five iron-shod spades behind. Extinguish the Mire Wisps and retrieve the tools.
accept_line: Without dry peat, Thornwick's ovens go cold by Newmoon. Watch where you plant your boots.
complete_line: Not a bend in the blades. My crew goes back to cutting at first light.

steps.journal: Peat-Cutter Mara's crew dropped five iron-shod spades when Mire Wisps rose out of Willow Sink.
Dispersed six Mire Wisps flickering over Willow Sink.
Recovered all five iron-shod spades from the sunken peat banks.
Handed the spades back to Peat-Cutter Mara so Thornwick's turf fires stay lit.

title: Mildewed Muster-Rolls
summary: Ruin Mites are chewing through the old levy-rolls stored in Ravenwatch's guard-cellar. Exterminate the nest and save the surviving muster ledgers.
objectives: Deliver the rolls to Captain Garrick
accept_line: Half the border families owe widow-silver on those pages. Do not let beetles eat their names.
complete_line: Ink's smeared, yet the seals hold. At least the dead will be paid properly.

steps.journal: Garrick needs four vellum muster-rolls pulled from the flooded cellar beneath Ravenwatch Keep.
Exterminated ten Ruin Mites chewing through the Ravenwatch cellar racks.
Salvaged four mildewed vellum muster-rolls from the upper shelves.
Delivered the muster-rolls to Sergeant Garrick, proving the border rosters were padded.

title: Tallow for the Third Post
summary: The limestone beacon along Lantern Passage burned dry after Cinder Shamans fouled its oil-cistern. Carry fresh tallow-casks up the switchback and relight the cage.
objectives: Eliminate the Cinder Shaman near loc-hermit-lamp-post
Refill and ignite the Third Lantern Post
accept_line: Without that high flame, night patrols walk blind straight off the slate ledge.
complete_line: Saw the blue spark catch from the gatehouse. Good work keeping the pass lit.

steps.journal: Watchman Joren needs the Third Lantern Post re-lit before night-fog swallows the Ashbrook pass.
Struck down the Cinder Shaman snuffing out the pass beacons.
Refilled and ignited the Third Lantern Post with clean tallow.
Reported the lit beacon to Watchman Joren.

title: Teeth of the Greywood Mill
summary: Thorn Boars rooted up the timber yard outside Greywood Water-Mill, scattering Dobb's tempered crosscut blades. Drive off the beasts and gather the steel.
accept_line: Those sows tusked straight through two-inch ash planks. Mind your shins in the sawdust.
complete_line: Not a chip on the teeth. We'll have palisade stakes stacked by sundown.

steps.journal: Sawyer Dobb asked me to clear Thorn Boars out of Greywood Sawmill and recover three tempered crosscut blades.
Cleared five Thorn Boars rooting around the Greywood millrace.
Retrieved three tempered steel crosscut blades from the timber shed.
Returned the saw blades to Sawyer Dobb so the palisade timber cut can resume.

title: Pitch for the Craghorn Cairns
summary: Early sleet blinded the watershed ridge above Ravenwatch, leaving scouts stranded in the pass. Haul pine-pitch barrels to relight the twin weather-cairns.
accept_line: If the ridge beacons stay dark, our northern pickets freeze before dawn.
complete_line: Two orange plumes against the sleet—every runner in the valley can steer by them now.

steps.journal: Runner Talia needs the two Craghorn Weather-Cairns lit with pitch oil to guide stragglers through the sleet.
Cleared four Glasswings circling the Craghorn ridge.
Ignited both Craghorn Weather-Cairns; orange smoke rose above the sleet line.
Reported the lit cairns to Runner Talia.

title: Stakes on Alder Bluff
summary: Quill Fiends nested in the white-clay gullies above Alder Bridge, sniping baggage mules from cover. Clear the ridge and plant sharpened ash stakes.
objectives: Place 4 Sharpened Ash Stakes along the embankment
accept_line: My archers can't trade shots uphill against bone-spitters. Sweep that bluff clean.
complete_line: Stakes are set and the clay is quiet. Wagons can cross without hugging their shields.

steps.journal: Garrick ordered sharpened ash stakes planted along Alder Bluff to break any flank rush.
Drove eight Quill Fiends off the chalk embankment at Alder Bluff.
Hammered four sharpened ash stakes deep into the bluff embankment.
Confirmed the Alder Bluff stakes are set with Sergeant Garrick.

title: Green Slag Cullets
summary: Widow Marta needs chunks of vitrified green silica from the old quarry kilns to grind into eye-salve powder, though Flintbacks sleep among the cold furnaces.
objectives: Gather 6 Green Silica Slag Chunks from loc-vitrified-kilns
Defeat 3 Flintbacks guarding the slag heaps
Bring the slag chunks to Widow Marta
accept_line: Crushed kiln-glass clears bog-film from sentry eyes better than boiled alum.
complete_line: Clean, bubble-free glass. Give my mortar an hour and the pickets will see clearly again.

steps.journal: Widow Marta wants six chunks of green vitrified kiln-slag from the old bell-smelting pits.
Defeated three Flintbacks guarding the vitrified slag heaps.
Collected six glassy chunks of green kiln-slag.
Delivered the green slag cullets to Widow Marta for her mortar.

title: Dog-Tags in the Turnip Rows
summary: After the Ashbrook skirmish, dozens of fallen militiamen were buried hastily in the south ditch with their stamped brass pay-disks. Recover the disks before Gloom Stags desecrate the cairns.
objectives: Drive off 3 Gloom Stags prowling loc-ashbrook-turnip-field
accept_line: Hobb stamped every one of those disks on his own anvil. Their mothers deserve the metal back.
complete_line: Seven names accounted for. I'll polish the mud off before the widow-bell rings.

steps.journal: Master Hobb asked me to recover stamped brass pay-disks from the Ashbrook turnip ditches so families can claim death-tally coin.
Drove three Gloom Stags out of the Ashbrook turnip rows.
Collected seven mud-caked brass pay-disks from the furrows.
Turned the seven pay-disks over to Master Hobb for the garrison ledger.

title: Bent Pikes of the Sunken Ford
summary: Rootbound hulks snapped half the garrison's boar-spears during the last ford patrol. Recover the broken steel heads from the creek bed so Hobb can re-weld them.
accept_line: Good border steel costs three silver a pound; I won't leave it rusting under trout.
complete_line: Bent, not cracked. Give me bellows-time till midnight and you'll have fresh points.

steps.journal: Master Hobb is short on bar-iron and wants six snapped pike-heads salvaged from Thornwick Weir.
Destroyed two Rootbound lurking among the weir pilings.
Pulled six bent iron pike-heads out of the tangled driftwood.
Delivered the scrap steel to Master Hobb's anvil.

title: Rawhide for the Jawbone Gate
summary: Dry desert winds split the rawhide lashings binding Redmarsh's leviathan-bone gate. Harvest tough Dune Beast hides to re-lash the timbers before the next dust squall.
objectives: Deliver 4 Thick Dune-Beast Hides to Warden Hale
accept_line: Iron nails snap in alkali salt; soaked rawhide shrinks tighter than forge-bands.
complete_line: Stretched wet and pegged tight. That gate will hold against a battering ram now.

title: Ash from the East Blind
summary: Sand-clan spotters etched caravan schedules and tribal clan-marks into the sandstone lintel of the East Jawbone Blind. Make charcoal rubbings before wind scours the stone.
objectives: Clear the Sand Raiders holding loc-jawbone-east-blind
accept_line: Every notch on that sandstone tells us which water-hole their warbands plan to hit next.
complete_line: Remarkable—they track moon-tides alongside caravan weights. Now we know where to ambush them.

title: Shattered Heliographs
summary: Raider scouts use polished bronze mirrors hidden in the Bracken Hoodoo Maze to flash ambush signals across the basin. Smash the mirror stands.
objectives: Navigate loc-bracken-hoodoos and destroy 4 Bronze Heliograph Stands
Eliminate 6 Dune Lurkers nesting in the maze
accept_line: Every time copper winks off those red pillars, an arrow finds one of my wheel-mules.
complete_line: No more flashes in the grit. My drivers can finally breathe between dust squalls.

title: Unbroken Naphtha Jars
summary: Unexploded clay firepots from the Highgate assault still lie half-buried in the dry arroyo. Recover the intact jars before Storm Kites spark the brush.
accept_line: Handle the stoppers like eggshells—one dropped jar turns that gully into a kiln.
complete_line: Five sealed pots, not a hairline crack. Highgate's wall-braziers are stocked for a month.

title: Leyden Horns of the Monolith
summary: Dune Scarabs drawn to the Third Quartz Monolith have grown charged copper horns capable of grounding wild static. Harvest their forked horns for Surveyor Nira.
accept_line: Without copper lightning-rods, the monolith's static will cook our survey instruments.
complete_line: Pure, conductive copper grown in carapace—Nira can ground the entire camp perimeter now.

title: Skimming the Milestone Well
summary: Maggot Swarms fouled the Bitter Milestone Well along the corduroy road, tainting the sole watering trough for ten leagues. Purge the larvae and drop quicklime bags.
objectives: Lower 3 Quicklime Purifying Sacks into the well
accept_line: Half the vanguard is chewing dry salt-beef because nobody dares dip a cup in that trough.
complete_line: The scum's settled and the lime is fizzing. By tomorrow noon the water will run sweet.

title: The Assay-Vault Balances
summary: Cask-Master Tull needs the precision brass balance-beams locked inside Redrock Canyon Vault to weigh salt-tax silver fairly, though Scale Vipers coil in the cool sandstone.
accept_line: Caravan masters cheat me two ounces on every bar with their filed-down pocket scales.
complete_line: True imperial weights, stamped and balanced. Let them try palming lead slugs now.

title: Bitumen from the Twelve Stones
summary: Witch Doctors at the Twelve Megaliths boil marsh bitumen with willow-ash to coat hex-stones. Scrape three jars of the thick residue for Widow Marta's counter-salves.
accept_line: To break a Redmarsh marrow-hex, you need the exact pitch they boiled their fetishes in.
complete_line: Stinks of rotted willow and snake-bile—precisely what I needed for the antidote.

title: Iron Keys of the Third Terrace
summary: Crypt Embalmers patrolling the Deep Quarry slave-pens still carry the heavy iron ward-keys to the lower tool-cribs. Recover the keys so Tomas's men can arm themselves.
accept_line: Two hundred sledgehammers and crowbars sit behind those bars—better weapons than bare fists.
complete_line: Every lock turns! My quarrymen will crack basalt skulls like limestone now.

title: Re-Carving the Crossroads
summary: With the decoy cairns gone, Crossroads Milestone still lacks legible league-marks for incoming relief columns. Escort a stone-cutter to re-chisel the four imperial glyphs.
objectives: Guard the mason at loc-four-faced-milestone against 2 waves of Sand Raiders
Verify all four directional glyphs are re-cut
accept_line: One wrong turn in an alkali fog marches a whole company straight into salt-quicksand.
complete_line: Deep, clean chiseling—even a half-blind courier can read the league-counts at a gallop.

title: Brine-Shield Pavises
summary: Giant Salt Crabs on the Greywash flats grow meter-wide shields of calcified salt and oak planking. Harvest four intact claws for Kors's marine boarding parties.
accept_line: Crossbow bolts glance right off those salt-crusted shells—cheaper than hammering iron pavises.
complete_line: Heavy as oak doors and twice as hard. My marines will thank you on the gangplanks.

title: Yellow Cakes from the Vents
summary: Cinderlings nesting in the cliffside fumaroles hoard pure sulfur crusts that Chief Healer Sera burns to fumigate gangrene wards. Gather five sulfur cakes.
accept_line: Nothing kills trench-rot in wet bandages faster than sharp sulfur smoke.
complete_line: Clean yellow brimstone—we can smoke out the lower triage tents before nightfall.

title: Chains of the Split Tooth
summary: Privateers strung rusted gibbet-cages across the Split Tooth pass, rattling nerves and blocking supply wains. Cut down the cages and clear the Hollow Knights.
accept_line: I will not march recruits past swinging bones every time they haul powder to the coast.
complete_line: The pass is clear and quiet. Let the dead rest beneath turf instead of iron bars.

title: Boiled Linen for the Nave
summary: Apothecary Linn's field hospital in the ruined chapel nave is out of clean bandaging cloth while Bog Dartblowers pick off stretcher-bearers in the bracken.
objectives: Deliver 4 Bales of Boiled Linen to Apothecary Linn
accept_line: We're tearing up altar-cloths to bind stump-wounds; bring clean linen before fever sets in.
complete_line: Dry, sealed bales—you just bought thirty wounded marines another week of life.

title: The Drowned Prism
summary: Before the sea-fortress flooded, the Drowned Lighthouse housed a brass-mounted crystal prism capable of piercing coastal fog. Recover it from the Lantern Eels.
accept_line: With that lens mounted on Oakhaven's tower, Kael's fire-ships can't sneak in under fog.
complete_line: Not a scratch on the crystal! Pilot Maren will have it bolted in by midnight.

title: Tide-Stakes on the Spit
summary: Storm surges washed away the depth-markers along Hourglass Shingle Spit, trapping heavily armored pickets when the tide turns. Hammer new iron tide-gauges at low water.
objectives: Reach loc-shingle-spit and drive in 4 Iron Tide-Gauges
Defeat 3 Frost Bells haunting the surf
accept_line: Thirty pounds of breastplate turns knee-deep surf into a grave if you misjudge the spit.
complete_line: White paint shows clear above the foam—no marine will drown blind on that gravel bar now.

title: Felling the Night Orchard
summary: Animated gallows-trees on the High-Orchard Terraces bombard Oakhaven's timber crews with screaming skull-fruit. Burn the blighted trunks down to ash.
accept_line: Woodcutters won't go near the ridge while those black branches keep throwing shrieking skulls.
complete_line: Nothing left but smoking stumps. The apple terraces belong to the living again.

title: Bronze Gears of Twin-Lock
summary: Lock-Keeper Orin needs heavy graphite grease-drums packed into the capstan pits before salt corrosion seizes the eastern floodgate ratchets.
objectives: Apply 3 Graphite Grease-Drums to the capstan gears
accept_line: If those ratchets rust solid, spring runoff floods every drydock in Oakhaven.
complete_line: Turned sweet as clockwork on the test crank. Those gates will hold through winter.

title: The Baron's Smuggler Ledgers
summary: Baron Vane kept coded harbor-pilot bribes locked in an iron strongbox at the base of his catacomb lift. Recover the ledgers before Hollow Kings scatter the vault.
accept_line: Every traitor opening sea-gates for Kael's privateers has a signature inside that box.
complete_line: Half the harbor guild is named here—we'll have the gallows busy before dawn.

title: Ramrods for the Culverin Wall
summary: Harborwatch's bronze coastal guns are fouling with black powder residue while Frosthorn Bruisers batter the seawall stairs. Deliver wet sheepskin sponge-rods to the gunners.
accept_line: One glowing ember left in a barrel blows the whole gun-crew straight over the parapet!
complete_line: Barrels swabbed and cooled—every culverin on the wall is barking again.

title: Razor-Glass of the Coves
summary: Redglass Drakes shedding wing-shards along the Obsidian Landing Coves leave razor-sharp volcanic glass capable of slicing demonic hide. Harvest intact wing-plates.
accept_line: Ordinary steel dulls after three chops on caldera plate; red volcanic glass holds an edge.
complete_line: Keen enough to split hair—Vok's apprentices can bind these straight onto spear-shafts.

title: Iron Chevaux-de-Frise
summary: Crowned Maws keep bounding over Highcrest Redoubt's shallow ash-trenches to maul wounded pickets. Anchor heavy iron-spiked barricades along the northern lip.
accept_line: Those bone-crowned beasts leap six paces from a crouch—give them iron spikes to land on.
complete_line: Spikes are bolted into basalt. Let them jump now and impale themselves.

title: Grounding the West Spire
summary: Residual lightning from the shattered West Focusing Crag arcs fatally into marching infantry. Bolt heavy copper grounding cables from the spire base into the ash.
accept_line: One flash off that violet crystal welded three pikemen inside their own breastplates.
complete_line: Static's bleeding harmlessly into the ash—troops can march past without hair standing on end.

title: Filling the Glacis Craters
summary: Molten catapult craters outside Greystone's east sally-port block cavalry sorties and hide burrowing Basalt Brutes. Clear the brutes and collapse the crater rims.
objectives: Collapse 4 Slag-Crater Rims with sapper charges
accept_line: Until that glacis is graded flat, our heavy riders can't charge out to break their siege lines.
complete_line: Ground's packed level and cool—Greystone's lancers have room to gallop again.

title: Grimoires of the Summit Stair
summary: Malrik's fleeing acolytes dropped three iron-clasped summoning grimoires on the Ashveil switchbacks. Recover the books before Rift Moths drain their wards.
accept_line: Unbound portal-lexicons left open in caldera wind can tear new rifts behind our camp.
complete_line: Clasps locked and warded—Elias will seal these inside lead caskets tonight.

title: Billets from the Unquenched Jaw
summary: Stoker Brann needs raw meteoric slag-billets cooled along the edges of the Unquenched Jaw fissure so Vok can re-forge shattered vanguard shields.
accept_line: Ordinary bog-iron turns soft as tallow inside the caldera; only fissure-slag holds temper.
complete_line: Dense, ringing metal—Vok's hammers are already singing over these billets.

title: Jamming the Magnetic Narrows
summary: Dread Knights hold the twin portcullis winches above Magnetic Iron Narrows, threatening to trap the vanguard mid-defile. Seize the gatehouses and wedge the chains.
accept_line: If those iron grates drop while our baggage train is inside, the canyon becomes a slaughter-pen.
complete_line: Both winches jammed with oak beams—neither grate will drop on our column.

title: Chains Over the Magma Moat
summary: Intense heat from the molten basalt river warped the six-inch iron links of the Citadel Drawbridge, while Cinderhorns guard the gatehouse murder-holes.
objectives: Cool and brace the 2 Main Drawbridge Windlasses
accept_line: One snapped link drops forty tons of iron span straight into liquid rock.
complete_line: Windlasses braced and pinned—our heavy siege engines can roll across safely.

title: Horns of Three-Roads Watch
summary: Ash Weavers spun incandescent fire-webs across the signal towers of Three-Roads Watch, cutting off communication with the flanking relief columns.
accept_line: Without horn-relays across the ash plain, our three divisions march blind into counter-attacks.
complete_line: Heard all three brass notes carry across the soot—the flanks are coordinated.

title: Ash for the Anchor Seals
summary: Penitent Sola needs consecrated First-Watch ash scattered around the cooling Anchor Seals inside the Threshold Nave before final assault begins.
accept_line: Let the seals hear the old oaths one final time before we force the threshold doors.
complete_line: The ash holds steady on the obsidian—whatever awaits behind those doors knows we are here.
